name: navigation-create
description: Create Tradebee website navigation with two-level and child-mode constraints.

language.description: Required exact enabled site language selected from languages-get.

navigation.description: Required navigation data. Each language supports at most 20 first-level items and navigation supports at most two levels.

parent_navigation_id.description: Defaults to 0 for a first-level item. For a second-level item, use a positive first-level ID returned by navigation-read where is_leaf=false; never use a second-level ID.

name.description: Required navigation display name containing 2-100 characters.

url.description: Required link containing 1-500 characters. Internal links must use /path without scheme or domain; external links must be absolute HTTP(S) URLs.

system_children_type.description: Defaults to 0. System child-navigation type: 0 disables system children; 1 first-level product groups; 2 news groups; 3 FAQ groups; 4 certificate groups; 5 case groups; 6 all product groups without cover images; 7 blog groups. Values 1-7 are first-level only and require content="" with no manual children.

content.description: Optional custom child-navigation HTML fragment for a first-level item. Before generating this field, call rule-get with the exact selected language and exact scene=navigation.content; stop if the call fails. Follow the returned payload: use one root section with a unique scoped class and one embedded style block at the end. Inline style attributes and external stylesheet links are forbidden. Do not include H1; prefer H2-H6. Each img src may be an HTTP(S) URL or data:image/...;base64,...; at most 50 images are allowed and each image must be at most 500 kB. The 100,000-character limit is calculated after removing img tags. The server uploads base64 images and replaces src with URLs. Use non-empty content only with system_children_type=0 and no manual children. It must be "" for system children, manual-child mode, and every second-level item.

open_in_new_window.description: Whether to open the navigation URL in a new browser window or tab. Defaults to false.

sort.description: Navigation sort value. Smaller values appear earlier; valid range is 1-999999.

confirmation.description: Required explicit approval for the exact payload.

approved.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly approves this operation.

summary.description: Summary of the exact language and navigation payload approved by the user.

output.description: API result containing navigation_id and is_leaf.
